Subject: Post-call: Elara integration — credentialing & key rotation plan

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same thread: 

Summary from our discovery (high level):
- Primary workload: patient-facing summarization + embeddings for search/rerank across clinical notes.
- Traffic profile: bursty reads (search) mid-day; steady generation for summaries overnight.
- Security posture: SOC2 in progress; currently using Okta for SSO/Tokens; security team prefers short-lived credentials and rotation visibility.

Key integration topics we covered that need decisions:
1) Authentication model: service accounts with signed JWTs (recommended) vs long-lived API keys for quick POC.
2) Key rotation: automated rotation via KMS + audit logs vs manual rotation cadence.
3) SDK & routing: embedding/reranker traffic separated from low-latency gen endpoints (routing policy + separate API keys/service accounts).
4) Structured output/tool calling: may require scoped credentials or per-service keys for least-privilege.

Proposed immediate next steps (owners + dates):
- Action: Share our SDK auth guide and a one-page rotation plan — owner: Monica (attached). Due: 2027-02-10 EOD.
- Action: Elara to confirm security contact + current Okta flow details (SAML/OIDC endpoints, token expiry). Owner: Sam. Due: 2027-02-11.
- Action: Schedule a 45-min architecture deep-dive (tokens, routing, envelope encryption) with Elara infra + Sec. Owner: Karthik to propose times. Due: 2027-02-12.

Attachments: redwood-sdk-auth-guide.pdf (PDF, SDK examples), redwood-service-account-rotation-plan.md (MD, ops steps)

If this looks right, Sam can reply with Priya's contact or add her to the thread and we'll lock the meeting.

Thanks,
Karthik

- We run Okta with OIDC for user auth; for service-to-service we currently create service accounts in our infra and issue JWTs with a 1h expiry.

Hi Sam / Priya — thanks for the details, this matches what I expected. A short technical proposal below so you can share with Sec/Infra before the deep-dive: 

Technical proposal (concise):
- Recommended production model: customer-managed service accounts + signed JWTs (recommended)
  - Elara generates short-lived JWTs (1h) signed by your key(s) in your KMS.
  - Redwood validates JWTs via JWKS endpoint (recommended) or accepts signed assertions with certificate pins.
  - Access is scoped by audience/claims to separate embedding/reranker scopes from generation scopes.
- Rotation and audit:
  - Keys remain in Elara KMS; rotation performed per your cadence.
  - Redwood supports automatic JWKS fetch + cached key rotation detection; audit logs (token usage, IP, model, route) can be exported to your S3 endpoint or pushed to Splunk/Datadog via webhooks.
- POC option (fast):
  - Create a short-lived API key (30d) scoped to a sandbox model and a dedicated routing tag. We'll recommend rotating after POC and switching to JWTs for prod.

Routing recommendations:
- Route embeddings and rerankers through a separate service account/credentials to enforce different throttles and cost accounting.
- For structured output/tool-calling, use per-tool scoped credentials to minimize blast radius if a key is leaked.

Attachments: redwood-service-account-rotation-plan.md (contains step-by-step KMS rotation, sample JWKS handler, and a script to rotate keys safely)

Next proposed schedule: 45-min deep-dive (Zoom + shared recording) — available slots:
- Thu Feb 11 10:00-11:00 EST
- Thu Feb 11 15:00-15:45 EST

- Prep sample JWKS validation snippet for the meeting.

Happy to jump on whichever time works for Priya / infra.
